name: Oven-Baked Chicken Dürüm Wraps with Garlic Sauce
ingredients:
CHICKEN
2.5 lb chicken drumsticks (8-10)
1/2 lemon, for rinsing (optional)

MARINADE
1/2 cup yogurt
3 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp paprika
1 tbsp dried oregano
1 tsp curry powder
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
1 tbsp salt

GARLIC SAUCE
4 garlic cloves
1/4 cup olive oil
1/2 cup mayonnaise
3 tbsp ketchup
1 shallot, finely chopped
Juice of 1/2 lemon
1 tsp salt

ASSEMBLY
4 large lavash or flour tortillas
1 lb frozen french fries
1/2 cup diced pickles
directions:
1. Optional: rinse the drumsticks with lemon and water, then pat dry. Cut 2-3 deep slits into each drumstick.
2. Whisk all marinade ingredients together in a large bowl. Add the chicken and coat thoroughly, working the marinade into the slits. Marinate at least 1 hour, or up to overnight in the fridge.
3. Heat the oven to 400°F. Line a baking dish with parchment, arrange the drumsticks in a single layer, and pour any remaining marinade over them.
4. Cover tightly with foil and bake 40 minutes. Uncover and bake 15-20 minutes more, until browned and 185°F internal.
5. While the chicken bakes, make the sauce: cook the garlic cloves in the olive oil over medium-low heat until golden and soft, 4-5 minutes. Mash the garlic with its oil, let cool slightly, then stir in the mayonnaise, ketchup, shallot, lemon juice, and salt.
6. Cook the fries according to package directions.
7. Pull the chicken off the bones in large shreds, discarding skin and bones if preferred. Toss the meat with the pan juices.
8. Spread garlic sauce over each lavash, then layer chicken, fries, and pickles down the center. Fold in the sides and roll tightly.
9. Heat a grill pan over medium. Brush the wraps with pan juices or oil and press seam-side down until golden with grill marks, 2-3 minutes per side.
10. Slice in half and serve with extra garlic sauce.
description: Turkish-style chicken wraps: yogurt-marinated drumsticks baked tender, pulled, and rolled in lavash with garlic-ketchup sauce, fries, and pickles, then pressed golden.
notes:
Marinade and sauce quantities are from Abir El Saghir's recipe. Chicken amount, marinating time, bake temp/time, and assembly details are estimates reconstructed from her video.

Salt: 1 tbsp salt plus 2 tbsp soy sauce makes a salty marinade. If using table salt instead of kosher, or serving kids, reduce the marinade salt to 2 tsp.

Use full-fat Greek or whole-milk yogurt so it clings to the chicken.
